notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Mouse cursor during story playback[/h3]
[list]
[*]When the cursor is released from the icon, the selection is canceled to reduce erroneous operation.
[*]The mouse cursor is now hidden when operating the controller on the story screen.
[/list]
[h3]Option setting tab switching with LR button[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed so that tab selection can be switched with the controller's LR button on the option setting screen.
[/list]
[h3]Fixed typos in scenarios[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed that Helen's dialogue was written as a researcher in Scenario 1-8.
[/list]

If the mouse cursor is not used during story playback, it will no longer appear, improving the sense of immersion and improving operability on the option screen.

Changed so that tab selection can be switched with the controller's LR button on the option setting screen.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h3]Added item descriptions for option settings[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added description display for each setting item.
[/list]
[h3]Added sensitivity adjustment for manual sighting[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added manual sighting sensitivity adjustment to option settings.
[/list]
[h3]Improved manual sighting operation[/h3]
[list]
[*]The mini-game (SHOOTING TARGET) has been made easier to play by eliminating the feeling of being caught in the sight under certain conditions.
[/list]
[h3]Swimsuit outfits of rival teams are added to the character dictionary.[/h3]
[list]
[*]After clearing the game, you can now see the rival teams in their swimsuits from the character dictionary.
[/list]

The operation feeling has been improved by improving the operation of manual aiming and adding sensitivity adjustment. You can also use gyro-aim in DualShock4 or DualSense by changing the game's option settings. (Steam input must be set to disabled.) It is easier to play if you use the right stick to adjust the misalignment. Please try it if you have it.

-Added manual sighting sensitivity adjustment to option settings.

notes.content:
[h3]Item description during pause[/h3]
[list]

[h3]Added a new image of the rival team in casual clothes to the character directory.[/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3]Adjustment of difficulty level[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the number of bullets in attacks on some bosses, etc.
[/list]
[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Made the ground a little darker to make it easier to see bullets in the sandy beach stage
[*]Status abnormalities should now be cleared upon revival.

The tutorial stage in the multiplayer mode makes it easier for each player to learn how to control the game. The single-player game has also been made easier to play by adjusting the boss attacks.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h3]Correction[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in the mini-game "Shooting Target" story mode that characters after 2P were not displayed during multiplayer.
[/list]
[h3]Supported backward compatibility for achievements and stage clear difficulty[/h3]
[list]
[*]Achievements have been changed to the final stage clear to make them easier to achieve.
[*]Achievements are backward-compatible, so that if you achieve an achievement on a higher difficulty level, you will also achieve it on a lower difficulty level.
[*]Changed to open the highest difficulty level from the beginning.
[*]If a stage is cleared on a higher difficulty level, it is also cleared on a lower difficulty level.
[*]Stage clear status is updated on loading even with saved data during play
[/list]
[h3]Display of Operation Guide[/h3]
[list]
[*]Guide to hide the menu in the pause menu during the stage is now displayed.
[*]Menu switching guide is now displayed on the mission selection screen.
[/list]

Those who wish to play for a longer period of time can start on Normal and work their way up, or they can challenge the highest difficulty level and complete the achievements efficiently.

Pause the game by pausing during a stage and hide the menu to make it easier to take screenshots of decisive scenes. Please enjoy it together with the screen effects in the options menu.
